ARROYO, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me, do hereby order:

text.en:
Reorganization. - The Subic-Clark Alliance for Development
Council is hereby reorganized. It shall be henceforth called as the Subic-Clark
Alliance for Development.

Chairman. - The Chairman of the Clark International Airport
Corporation shall serve as the Chairman of the SCAD.

Repealing Clause. - Executive Order No. 733 (s. 2008) is hereby
amended accordingly. All other executive issuances, orders, rules and
regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive
Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

- This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 10th day of March in the year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Ten.
By the President:
LEANDRO'R./MENDOZA
Executive Secretary
PGMA Hologram • 56703
